popup.title: Adder Swamp
popup.description: A dangerous expanse of [[lycanthrope]]-infested marshland that surrounded the [[Adder River]] delta in [[Chessenta]].

popup.title: Mortik Swamp
popup.description: Also spelled '''Mortick Swamp''', inhabited by monsters, namely [[merrow]] and [[scrag]]s, which often raided nearby lands.

popup.title: Great Swamp of Rethild
popup.description: Also known as the '''Great Swamp''' or ''Rethild'' and ''Kethid,''' a swamp in [[Dambrath]] filled with dangerous creatures and diseases like [[cackle fever]] and [[mindfire]].

popup.title: Lhespenbog
popup.description: A small wetland of sprawling [[reed]]-fields used in creation of the [[enchanted]] [[staves]] – ''[[Aiedo wither-stick]]s''.

popup.title: Kilmaruu Swamp
popup.description: A stretch of [[undead]]-infested swamp and marshland where a ruined city stood. The swamp was the topic of the infamous [[Halruaa]]n strategic ''[[Kilmaruu Paradox]]''.

popup.title: Swamp of Akhlaur
popup.description: Also known as the '''Swamp of Ghalagar''', was a magically created swamp from a ''[[gate]]'' to the [[Elemental Plane of Water]], closed permanently in [[1373 DR]].

popup.title: Spider Swamp
popup.description: The fetid swamp, formed by a great [[marid]]'s death in the [[Steam Clashes]] of [[−7687 DR]].

popup.title: Umber Marsh
popup.description: A large patch of boggy land on the border of [[Aglarond]] and [[Thay]], virtually impassible with many small springs and streams running across the wetlands, and eventually daring into [[River Lapendrar]].

popup.title: Surmarsh
popup.description: A dreary, humid swamp with its stench being especially wretched during the summer.

popup.title: Zehoarast Floodplains
popup.description: The floodplains that encompassed the lowlands between the [[River Esmel]] and the [[Small Teeth]] and west of the [[Trade Way]].

popup.title: Wetwoods
popup.description: Also known as the '''Flooded Forest''', a misty bog of [[fungus]]-coated trees.

popup.title: Farsea Marshes
popup.description: A wetland that once was home to an ancient civilization lost to time. The remnants of their astonishingly resilient structures were buried beneath the wetlands.

popup.title: Vast Swamp
popup.description: A dangerous swamp populated by tribes of [[lizardfolk]], [[hobgoblin]]s, and other [[goblinoid]]s, [[orc]]s, [[gnoll]]s, and [[troll]]s.

popup.title: Marsh of Tun
popup.description: Also known as the '''Fens of Tun''', a moderate-weather swamp lying in the [[Tunlands]] between the [[Sunset Mountains]] and the [[Stormhorns]].

popup.title: Gritstone Moorland
popup.description: A region of wetlands found on the eastern stretch of the [[Dragon Coast]] in the [[Eastern Heartlands]].

popup.title: Nameless Swamp
popup.description: A wetland of note.

popup.title: Lizard Marsh
popup.description: A large [[lizardfolk]], giant insect, [[black dragon]]-infested bayou in the delta of the [[Delimbiyr]] river.

popup.title: High Moor
popup.description: A large, monster-infested, open moorland in [[western Faerûn]], created in about [[-10500 DR]] when the kingdom of [[Miyeritar]] fell.

popup.title: Marsh of Chelimber
popup.description: A marsh or pungent [[sulfur]]ous steam pools inhabited by numerous [[lizardfolk]], [[bullywug]]s, and [[siv]]s.

popup.title: Stump Bog
popup.description: A bog to the east of the hamlet of [[Rassalantar]], inhabited by [[giant crab]]s, [[giant crayfish]], [[giant eel]]s, [[giant frog]]s, [[giant leech]]es, [[giant lizard]]s, [[giant wasp]]s, and [[giant slug]]s.

popup.title: Twilight Marsh
popup.description: A coastal swamp typically blanketed with heavy rain and thick fog in the early hours of the morning, fed by the waters of the [[Trank River]].

popup.title: Glumpen Swamp
popup.description: The waters of the swamp amidst barren lands originated from the [[Lake Longreach]] found to the northwest in [[the Ride]].

popup.title: Flooded Forest
popup.description: A section of the great forest of [[Cormanthor]] that laid beyond the [[River Lis]], flooded and transformed into a swamp home of [[lizardfolk]] and [[black dragon]]s.

popup.title: Glaun Bog
popup.description: A swamp of note, to the south of [[Sun Hills]].

popup.title: Glumpen Swamp
popup.description: The swamp fed by the waters of the swamp originated from [[Lake Longreach]] found to the northwest in the [[Ride]].

popup.title: Altispinax Swamp
popup.description: A dangerous swamp, homeland of predatory [[altispinax]] [[dinosaur]]s.

popup.title: Lonely Moor
popup.description: Area of boggy terrain occupied by bands of [[gnoll]]s and [[bugbear]]s.

popup.title: Cold Marshes
popup.description: Small frigid marshland adjacent to the [[Fell Woods]], infested with [[spider]]s, [[ettercap]]s, [[wyvern]]s, [[snow troll]]s, and frequented by [[barbarian]]s of the north.

popup.title: Bottomless Bogs
popup.description: An extensive area of cold swampland, foul mires, and smelly lakes in northwestern [[Vaasa]].

popup.title: Mere of Dead Men
popup.description:
Also known as '''Merdelain''', meaning "Slow Marching Court" in [[Elvish]]; the swamp's sinister name referred to the thousands of [[dwarves]], [[elves]], and [[human]]s of the [[Fallen Kingdom]] who were slain here during the invasion of an [[orc]] army in [[
615 DR]].

popup.title: Codsbay Mire
popup.description: A wetland where the [[Codsrun Creek]] delta met the [[Strait of Oman]].

popup.title: Leechhome
popup.description: A swamp of note.

popup.title: Drowned Forest
popup.description: Also known as the '''Browned Forest''', a marshland located in the kingdom of [[Callidyrr]].

popup.title: Tearglade
popup.description: A marshland located along the eastern shore on the [[Sea of Swords]] where the [[Swanmay River]] met the sea.

popup.title: Taeya Bog
popup.description: A coastal marshland of note.

popup.title: Black Maw Bog
popup.description: A small bog with a bridge that allowed the [[Long Road]] to cross over.

popup.title: Fens of the Fallen
popup.description: Wetlands of note.

popup.title: Mere Adammair
popup.description: A small marshland of note.

popup.title: Maloren Sods
popup.description: A large coastal swamp on the island of [[Snowdown]].

popup.title: Meirig Peatlands
popup.description: A large peat swamp.

popup.title: Breasal Marsh
popup.description: A peat-rich marshland inhabited by various tribes of [[lizardfolk]].

popup.title: The Frostfenn
popup.description: A large marshland of note.
